import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] field1 = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] field2 = new char[15][15];
    static final int[] dr = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dc = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][] nodeId = new int[65][15][15];
    static int[][] distFromZ = new int[15][15];
    static int nextNodeId = 1;

    static class FlowEdge {
        int from, to;
        long capacity, flow;

        FlowEdge(int f, int t, long c) {
            from = f;
            to = t;
            capacity = c;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class DinicMaxFlow {
        int nodes;
        List<FlowEdge> edgeList;
        List<List<Integer>> adjacency;
        int[] level;
        int[] nextEdge;

        DinicMaxFlow(int n) {
            nodes = n;
            edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
            adjacency = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adjacency.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n];
            nextEdge = new int[n];
        }

        void insertEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            if (u == v) return;
            edgeList.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, cap));
            adjacency.get(u).add(edgeList.size() - 1);
            edgeList.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, 0));
            adjacency.get(v).add(edgeList.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean createLevelGraph(int source, int sink) {
            Arrays.fill(level, nodes + 1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(source);
            level[source] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == sink) break;
                for (int idx : adjacency.get(u)) {
                    FlowEdge e = edgeList.get(idx);
                    if (e.flow < e.capacity && level[e.to] > level[e.from] + 1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[e.from] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[sink] <= nodes;
        }

        long push(int u, int sink, long bottleneck) {
            if (u == sink || bottleneck == 0) return bottleneck;
            for (int i = nextEdge[u]; i < adjacency.get(u).size(); i++) {
                nextEdge[u] = i;
                FlowEdge e = edgeList.get(adjacency.get(u).get(i));
                if (level[e.to] == level[e.from] + 1) {
                    long available = e.capacity - e.flow;
                    if (bottleneck != -1 && available > bottleneck) available = bottleneck;
                    long pushed = push(e.to, sink, available);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        edgeList.get(adjacency.get(u).get(i) ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long computeMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            long total = 0;
            while (createLevelGraph(source, sink)) {
                Arrays.fill(nextEdge, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = push(source, sink, -1)) > 0) {
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distFromZ[i], -1);
        }
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                field1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int layer = 0; layer <= t + 1; layer++) {
            for (int row = 1; row <= n; row++) {
                for (int col = 1; col <= n; col++) {
                    nodeId[layer][row][col] = nextNodeId++;
                }
            }
        }
        nextNodeId++;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                field2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (field1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    distFromZ[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int y = cell[0], x = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ny = y + dr[d], nx = x + dc[d];
                if (ny >= 1 && ny <= n && nx >= 1 && nx <= n && field1[ny][nx] != 'Y' && distFromZ[ny][nx] == -1) {
                    distFromZ[ny][nx] = distFromZ[y][x] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{ny, nx});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (distFromZ[i][j] == -1) distFromZ[i][j] = (int) 1e9;
                if (distFromZ[i][j] > t) distFromZ[i][j] = (int) 1e9;
            }
        }
        
        int sourceNode = 0;
        int sinkNode = nextNodeId - 1;
        DinicMaxFlow flowNet = new DinicMaxFlow(nextNodeId);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (field1[i][j] >= '1' && field1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    flowNet.insertEdge(sourceNode, nodeId[0][i][j], field1[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (field1[i][j] == 'Y' || field1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int ny = i + dr[d], nj = j + dc[d];
                    if (ny >= 1 && ny <= n && nj >= 1 && nj <= n && field1[ny][nj] != 'Y' && field1[ny][nj] != 'Z') {
                        for (int step = 0; step < t; step++) {
                            if (distFromZ[ny][nj] >= step + 1 && distFromZ[i][j] > step) {
                                flowNet.insertEdge(nodeId[step][i][j], nodeId[step + 1][ny][nj], 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (field1[i][j] == 'Y' || field1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int step = 0; step <= t; step++) {
                    if (field2[i][j] >= '1' && field2[i][j] <= '9') {
                        flowNet.insertEdge(nodeId[step][i][j], nodeId[t + 1][i][j], field2[i][j] - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (field1[i][j] == 'Y' || field1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                if (field2[i][j] >= '1' && field2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    flowNet.insertEdge(nodeId[t + 1][i][j], sinkNode, field2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println((int) flowNet.computeMaxFlow(sourceNode, sinkNode));
    }
}
